Dog Age Converter

For information only — not veterinary advice. Ageing varies by breed, health and lifestyle.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your dog's age in years (decimals allowed, e.g. 2.5).
  2. Pick your dog's size class (small, medium or large).
  3. Compare the epigenetic formula result with the size-based chart result and life stage.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the epigenetic dog-age formula?

human_age = 16 × ln(dog_age) + 31, published by Wang et al. in Cell Systems (2019), based on DNA-methylation comparison of Labrador retrievers and humans. It is not a straight multiplier — dogs age fast early, then slow down.

Why do the two methods give different answers?

Small breeds age slowest per year: 1 yr = 15, 2 yrs = 24, then ≈ +4/yr. Large breeds age fastest: 6 yrs ≈ 45, 10 yrs ≈ 66. Pick your dog's size to see the difference.

Is one method more accurate?

Yes — the size chart shows big dogs age faster per year, while the single epigenetic curve is breed-averaged. Presenting both lets you compare.
